messages:
anjali: heads-up: hit a streaming stall in the quickstart-streaming-auth sample when our creds rotate mid-stream using the new SlimGen API.

devon: can you describe the stall?

anjali: we start SlimGen with the request ctx, spawn a goroutine that calls gen.Next() and writes tokens. if UpdateCredentials runs (async refresh), gen.Next() returns an empty chunk with nil err, and subsequent Next() never returns. handler exits, goroutine leaks.

li: hm. does UpdateCredentials swap the HTTP transport? that can close underlying conn and confuse the reader.

anjali: yes, we call client.UpdateCredentials(ctx, tok) which swaps the auth header and rotates transport if needed. logs show repeated "read: 0 bytes" and then silence. no error bubbled up.

sam: can you paste the minimal pattern?

anjali: sure:
```go
ctx := r.Context()
g := client.NewSlimGenerator(ctx, opts)
go func() {
  for {
    part, err := g.Next()
    if err != nil { break }
    io.WriteString(w, string(part))
  }
}()
// background token refresher calls client.UpdateCredentials(...)
```

li: two UX issues: 1) ctx ownership for generator is unclear (should SDK derive a child ctx?), 2) UpdateCredentials needs a clear contract for in-flight streams.

devon: proposals: expose Gen.Interrupt() to forcibly unblock Next() immediately; keep Close() as graceful wait; and make UpdateCredentials non-blocking and cause an explicit ErrAuthRotated on affected streams.

sam: +1 on ErrAuthRotated. tests should assert deterministic errors when creds rotate. Also add an explicit example showing the recommended server pattern to avoid leaks.

anjali: quick sample for docs I'd share:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(r.Context())
g := client.NewSlimGenerator(ctx, opts)
defer g.Interrupt() // forces immediate unblock on handler exit
for {
  tok, err := g.Next()
  if err != nil { break }
  w.Write(tok.Data)
}
cancel()
```

li: note: Interrupt() must not block on the streaming reader. it should close internal readers and return fast.

devon: will add API sketch in RFC: Gen.Interrupt(), Gen.CloseGraceful(), client.UpdateCredentials(ctx, tok) returns immediately but marks streams as stale; streams return ErrAuthRotated. also add a ctx-factory option for generators for advanced patterns.

sam: I'll own tests: simulate credential rotation during a long poll and assert Next() yields ErrAuthRotated, and that calling Interrupt() unblocks immediately. also add a leak detector in the sample CI.

ci-bot: opened issue #4890: "go-sdk: SlimGen interrupt API + auth-rotation e2e" and linked this thread.

li: docs: update Go quickstart streaming page with the Interrupt pattern and add a short section "handling credential rotation". include recommended retry: on ErrAuthRotated, wait for refresh and retry once.

anjali: thanks all. this fixes a major onboarding friction for our sample app. will validate once PRs land. :rocket:

devon: assigning reviewers: @li for API, @sam for tests, @anjali for sample patch.

anjali: ping me when branches are ready, I'll smoke-test in the quickstart.
